# crosswork_groupings (Data Source)

This data source fetches all groups of a classifier, such as the device access groups

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_groupings" "example" {
  classifier = "DeviceAccess"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `classifier` (String) Group classifier
  - Choices: `DeviceAccess`, `LocationDevices`, `UserDefinedDevices`, `TopologyTypeDevices`, `DeviceType`, `UserDefinedPorts`, `PortType`

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `items` (Attributes Set) List of the groups of the classifier (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `discovery_type` (String) How the group came to exist, for example `StaticSystem` for a built-in group, `Static` for a group created by a user and `Dynamic` for a group the system maintains
- `id` (String) Group id
- `name` (String) Group name
- `parent_id` (String) Id of the parent group, not set for a root group
- `path` (String) Names of the group and its parents, separated by `/`, for example `Location/All Locations/AWS`
- `subgroups_allowed` (Boolean) Whether subgroups can be created under the group
